title: Settle captured remote receipts in terminal-child and idle-wait queue removal paths
outcome: Decide and cover truthful never-sent status for unattempted direct prompts removed by terminal delegation-child queue clearing or idle-wait Stop, using actual primary-owner custody.
acceptance: Both terminal-child queue clearing and idle-wait workflow-continuation removal have explicit behavior controls for retained remote receipts; definitive pre-write cancellation records a truthful terminal state while preserved heads and uncertain receipts keep their status and immutable identity.
